spots.text: NOW SERVING 482. Please wait until your number is called.

secrets.name: Behind the Door
secrets.text: Behind the door everybody is waiting for there is a small office: a desk, a bell, a roll of tickets, a lever to change the number. And another door, with another number over it, one less.

meta.label: The Waiting Room
meta.blurb: Hundreds of chairs, all facing one door, and over the door a number in green light. You look down: you are holding a ticket. It is not your number. It is never your number.
